Dr. Csaba Felkai - we were with him with our cat. He was condescending, arrogant. We did not receive an invoice, only cash payment was possible. We did not receive the x-ray taken upon request, even though we paid for it! I note that 68,000 HUF, which included x-ray, anesthesia, prescription writing and tartar removal. If we had to go further with the cat, of course we would not take it here, but this would expose it to unnecessary radiation again. This is what outrages me.
This was our first time here and the doctor has amazing attention, patience, and experience with his patients and their owners.

Amazing Doctor whom we know for more than 15 years. I highly recommend this clinic to any owner for great care of pets and the expertise in treatments.

Our relationship started because of a behavioral problem, and it turned out to be a thyroid problem. The Doctor went through the options, with a risk analysis, and suggested a step-by-step solution. Objectively, firmly, kindly. No side conversations, unnecessary circles. I am very grateful to him, because the structured therapy (drug treatment to bring it to a relatively normal value, then surgery) brought the expected result. I am especially grateful that he did not write off the old cat, based on the lab he saw in it the possibility of a nice recovery. But he did not deceive me by saying that everything would definitely be resolved in one fell swoop. He correctly outlined what I could expect, what the best and worst versions were. I met a professional specialist and I can only recommend him to those owners where professional knowledge and expertise are at the top of the priority list. I thank him that my cat was able to return to the felinely relaxed world of quality everyday life. :)

We owe a big thank you to the doctor. Today we waited for 2 hours in another office for an X-ray after my dog ​​swallowed a plum seed. After 2 hours, they didn't even call us. While waiting, I called Dr. Csaba Felkai, who said he was waiting for us in his office for an X-ray. By then it was 11 o'clock and the doctor had an appointment until noon. We got there in 10 minutes and the X-ray was done quickly. During the examination, the doctor determined that scaling was necessary and if we thought about it, he would do it. It was clear that this would not fit into the morning opening hours, but he still cleaned the dog's teeth very thoroughly and pulled out 2 bad teeth. We owe him gratitude and thanks!

Not long ago, 1 week ago, our cat Pamut was sick, vomiting, had a bad sense of smell, he was losing more and more weight, we didn't know what was wrong with him, in the last 1 hour we called the doctor to see if we could go in urgently, which they accepted, we took him in, the doctor examined him, he did everything for my cat to get better, the next day he was already eating, drinking, playing, as if he had never been sick, even his behavior changed, as if our cat was nicer to us now, he hasn't been very nice before, I highly recommend this place and thank you very much, :Our cat Pamut thanks you too!

I brought our dog for ultrasonic tartar removal, which according to preliminary e-mail information, is performed in this office under anesthesia.
Doctor Felkai explained everything in detail. Fast, precise, thorough. Our dog left the office on his own even sooner than the promised 1-hour treatment. Thank you for the advice you provided on how to keep his teeth healthy for as long as possible!
I highly recommend it!
We received perfect care, thorough treatment and love for our dog here. Got solutions for all. Highly recommended Doctor and place.

Dear Doctor!!
Thank you very much and I am infinitely grateful to you!!! Thank you very much for healing my dog ​​(Bella) and giving me peace of mind at the same time. I have met many animal doctors in my life but I have NEVER met one like Doctor!! I will definitely recommend you to anyone I know because, apart from his knowledge, he provides for his patients and their relatives with HEART and SOUL!!!!!!
Thank you very much for everything you have done for us!!
Hampe Beatrix
Thank you very much Eva!

We are very satisfied with the Doctor! We have had our shelter cat for 2 years and the first doctor we went to was not nice to the cat or to us. On top of that, he couldn't treat our problem either.
When we came here, it was as if we had fallen into another dimension. He is kind and patient with our cat, he treats her very nicely and reassuringly. The teeth were the main source of the problems, which he has successfully treated 2-3 times. Our cat was always able to eat that same evening and felt better.
No matter what other minor problems we turned to him for, he always tried to help in the simplest, least invasive way.
We had blood tests and lab work done by him and because of his reassuring attitude, our cat tolerated it very well.
We recommend him to everyone!
Thank you so much for always helping my dogs. I hope we will work together for a long time!
I have had my working dog here for almost 30 years and many times. The problems are treated 100%, plus at a more favorable price!!!
I have been going to the doctor for many years and I can say that he is the most professional among veterinarians! Thank you Henrik Lillin!

I came here to get my dog’s nails trimmed. The employee (I can’t call him a doctor) first asked me to put the dog on the table. Then he started putting a “muzzle” on my dog’s head. What he did next shocked me: he took a belt and wrapped it tightly around my dog’s neck. He then showed me how to hold the belt, which almost strangled my poor dog. He then tied a thin piece of string tightly around the dog’s nose and secured the ends to the belt.

When I simply asked if they had a more humane muzzle, he immediately threw it away, saying he “ran out of patience.” He told me to find another vet, that I had no right to “educate” him, and that I should have made an appointment in advance. He also added, and I quote, “I’m the boss here.” I would have gladly waited, come back another time, or brought my own muzzle – if someone had told me in advance. But to be let in without a word and then thrown out like that is beyond me.

I have been to dozens of vets, but I have never encountered such incompetence and arrogance from a so-called “professional”.

My dog ​​has chronic allergies, his nails are extremely brittle, and his blood vessels run close to his extremities, so I was actually relieved that I did not let this fake doctor treat him. Who knows what damage he could have done.

My dog's health is incredibly important to me, so there was no question that I had to find his doctor. After a few minor hiccups, I finally settled on Dr. Csaba Felkai's office a few years ago. I love that the Doctor dispels my wildest misconceptions about my dog's "serious and rare" illness in a matter of seconds; if he senses my concern, he sees me almost immediately, or even the same day. I also like that I get my turn at a pre-arranged appointment without crowds or waiting. I trust his knowledge and empathy, and I will continue to count on his help.

I sincerely recommend the doctor.
He saved our little Bonika at the last minute.
He performed a life-saving operation on her. Our puppy had uterine inflammation, which unfortunately was in such a critical stage that immediate intervention was needed.
We were examined early in the afternoon when the doctor announced that immediate surgery was necessary or our little Bonika would have passed away in a few days.
Without hesitation, our little dog underwent the surgery and returned to us 2 days later with good health and tail wagging.
Gratitude and thanks to a doctor who is humane, loves animals, and dedicates his life to healing.
Thank you and eternal gratitude, dear Doctor!
Bonika and owner
Krisztina Takács

The Doctor immediately accepted my request and calmly and professionally helped me even during the holidays!
5* I dare to recommend!

I highly recommend the doctor! He is an excellent, thorough professional, and he also understands the "language" of dogs. Our eight-month-old puppy loves going to him. He was always available, in urgent cases, willing to help outside of office hours, and even personally at our disposal.

My dog ​​and I went to see Dr. Felkai for tartar removal and a general dental checkup. In my opinion, he did a professional job, provided us with many useful tips, and his attitude was impeccable as a person. I can wholeheartedly recommend him.
